limitations: Only eight full W3/W7 source files were independently sampled; dependent consumers/tests were inspected narrowly and existence checked in immutable Git.
Raw Git blobs are canonical; Windows checkout CRLF normalization may change on-disk byte SHA256. Both values are shown separately and LF-normalized checkout content is compared against Git.
No runtime browser, database, API, CI, or security test executed; source-defined expected behavior is not runtime confirmation.
Do not claim final 12-sample or complete ledger PASS. Await W1 and W6 frozen records, then independently sample 2 W1 + 2 W6.
No original W3/W7 records, product, docs, UI, schemas, CI, issues, PRs, branches, or remotes were edited.
